reviews.comment:
El servicio de playa muy bien. Los baños resultan chicos e insuficientes. YPF full redujo el tamaño de los alimentos, los rolls ahora tienen 3/4 partes de lo q eran antes. Si se hacen tres cuadras adentro en panadería Newen se consigue mejor comida y a mejor precio

(Translated by Google)
The beach service was very good. The restrooms are small and insufficient. YPF Full has reduced the portion sizes of the food; the rolls are now three-quarters the size they used to be. If you walk three blocks inland, you can find better food at a better price at the Newen bakery.

reviews.comment:
Nos dieron  hamburguesas recalentadas,supuestamente estaban recién hechas pero  las recalentaron con el emboltorio plateado que traen. No tenían los precios exibidos y la cajera nos dijo de mala gana las distintas opciones. La nueva hamburguesa spice que ofrecen es un fraude. 11.000 pesos mal gastados.

(Translated by Google)
They gave us reheated hamburgers; supposedly they were freshly made, but they reheated them in the silver wrapping they come in. The prices weren't displayed, and the cashier reluctantly told us about the different options. The new "spice" burger they offer is a rip-off. 11,000 pesos wasted.
